composition: This project composes with the GLOBAL policy at ~/.config/opencode/model-routing/policy.json, which owns model ordering and selection logic. This file contains ONLY project deltas.

projectPrivacyGates.rule: Private purchase history and the JAMA PDF must only be processed by models with privacy.trainsOnRequests=false AND retentionDays=0 in the GLOBAL policy models map (currently: glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.3, kimi-k2.7-code, glm-5.3-flash-free, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, qwen3.8-flash, minimax-m3.1-flash, mimo-v2.6-flash). Beam Free (30-day retention) and all feedback-collecting free models are PROHIBITED for these files.
projectPrivacyGates.shippingRule: Anything routed into index.html / meal-plan-data.json / nutrition-reviewed.json or shipped assets is PUBLIC. Treat it as publication.
